sources.citation: Castro, Andy, Brian Crook and Royce Flaming. 2010. A sociolinguistic survey of Kua-nsi and related Yi varieties in Heqing county, Yunnan province, China. SIL Electronic Survey Report 2010-001. Dallas: SIL International. 96 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Sociolinguistic survey (lexicostatistics, Levenshtein distance, RTT, vitality). Sonaga is the Xinfeng data point; 545-item phonetic wordlist in Appendix G (pp.60-92) transcribed with Chao tone letters (fn.9: tones 21/33/55, 44 = mid raised by tense vowel, fn.23); App. G p.60 states 'Phonemic analysis was not carried out'. No suprasegmental discussion; the words stress/accent do not occur in a phonological sense anywhere in the text.

sources.citation: Duan Ling 段伶. 1998. 彝族夸恩斯支系语言初探 [Preliminary study of the language of the Kua'ensi (Kua-nsi) branch of the Yi]. 大理师专学报 (Journal of Dali Teachers College) 1998(2).
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: Only published linguistic description of any Heqing Yi variety (the closely related sister language Kua-nsi, kuan1249); a Chinese 概况-style sketch would normally have a 语音 section that may remark on 轻声/重音. Would not be first-hand for Sonaga itself.
